stages.description: Audit demonstrable capabilities, portfolio evidence, delivery speed, and tools to identify a marketable service.

why_now.marketplace_shift: Fiverr has evolved from a low-price commodity gig hub into a professional service marketplace where buyers seek vetted, competent specialists with clear scope, transparent pricing, and dependable delivery standards.
why_now.ai_impact: Fiverr explicitly welcomes responsible AI assistance that enhances freelancer productivity while requiring customized, original work and strictly prohibiting deceptive, low-quality, or unmodified synthetic outputs.
why_now.performance_system: Fiverr's performance framework (including Success Score, client satisfaction metrics, and seller levels) rewards consistent quality, on-time delivery, clear communication, and dispute prevention over superficial keyword stuffing.
why_now.economic_reality: Operating on Fiverr requires financial realism: calculating take-home earnings after the platform's 20% commission, direct production costs, software expenses, currency conversion, and withdrawal fees.

fiverr_performance_2027.heading: Build Better Gigs Through Relevance and Quality — Not Ranking Tricks.
fiverr_performance_2027.approved_copy: Learn how Fiverr evaluates marketplace relevance and seller performance. Develop accurate service listings, original portfolio evidence, clear packages and reliable delivery practices while understanding that search placement and seller levels depend on multiple factors.

responsible_ai_workflows.heading: Use AI as an Assistant. Deliver Original Work With Human Accountability.
responsible_ai_workflows.platform_principle: Fiverr permits responsible AI assistance across service categories subject to platform policies. However, AI must support the freelancer's own work and skill; deliverables must meet client needs; output should be meaningfully customized; originality and quality matter; client preferences must be respected; and misleading or deceptive uses are strictly prohibited.
appropriate_uses: Assisting in niche research, competitor positioning analysis, and buyer persona mapping
Refining gig description clarity, grammatical flow, and bullet-point formatting
Drafting relevant buyer FAQs and structured onboarding question templates
Improving the professional tone and conciseness of buyer communication templates
Reviewing proposal scope and suggesting quality assurance checklists for client orders
Translating non-English client requirements or clarifying technical briefs
Brainstorming layout concepts and typography combinations for gallery asset designs
mandatory_human_review: Verify that all described skills and deliverables reflect genuine student capabilities
Ensure all package deliverables and timelines are practically achievable by the student
Verify originality, copyright ownership, and commercial licenses for all delivered assets
Audit all factual claims, data points, and technical specifications for complete accuracy
Check that buyer AI preferences are fully respected before using AI tools on deliverables
Ensure client confidential information or proprietary files are never entered into public AI models
Confirm that final deliverables exhibit genuine human craftsmanship, customization, and polish
prohibited_ai_uses: Generating and publishing fake buyer reviews, testimonial quotes, or feedback ratings
Creating fabricated portfolio samples, fake case study results, or artificial client logos
Selling generic, unmodified AI outputs as skilled custom creative or technical services
Generating deceptive deepfakes, synthetic voice clones, or unauthorized likenesses
Uploading client confidential data, private briefs, or source code to unvetted AI engines
Automating deceptive spam messaging or mass cold-outreach campaigns across Fiverr
Fabricating seller identities, personal credentials, degrees, or country locations
Delivering AI-assisted work when a client explicitly requested 100% human-crafted output
responsible_ai_workflows.safe_ai_prompt_example: Review this fictional Fiverr gig description for clarity, service relevance and professionalism. Use only the verified skills and deliverables provided. Do not invent previous clients, ratings, results, professional experience, software access or guaranteed delivery outcomes. Flag ambiguous scope and potentially misleading claims.

account_eligibility_and_offline_pathway.heading: Account Eligibility, Platform Security & Offline Certification Pathway
account_eligibility_and_offline_pathway.eligibility_rules: Fiverr requires account users to be adults of legal majority. Eligible users aged 13–17 may participate on Fiverr only through an account owned and supervised by a parent or legal guardian in accordance with platform policy. Students must never be instructed or encouraged to falsify their age, identity, or location.
account_eligibility_and_offline_pathway.desktop_requirement: Freelancer account activation and initial gig creation must be performed on a desktop or laptop computer via Fiverr's web platform, as documented by official platform requirements.
account_eligibility_and_offline_pathway.offline_dossier_alternative: Nova Skills provides an equal, fully supported offline certification pathway. Students who are ineligible, under 18 without guardian accounts, lack required verification documents, or prefer not to maintain public commercial profiles may submit offline gig dossiers and simulated order workflows. Offline submissions are evaluated with identical academic rigor and receive full certification credit.
account_security: Enforce strong unique passwords and activate two-factor authentication (2FA)
Recognize phishing attempts, fake buyer verification links, and suspicious login redirects
Maintain all communications, custom offers, and order deliveries strictly on Fiverr's platform
Never share login credentials, OTP codes, personal phone numbers, or external payment details
Scan and verify all client-supplied files using updated antivirus software prior to opening

components.title: Deliverable 01 — Fiverr Gig Dossier A
deliverables: Target buyer persona and specific client problem statement
Service category and subcategory classification with category metadata
Optimized gig title complying with Fiverr length and keyword standards
Five relevant, intent-driven search tags matching buyer queries
Professional gig description structured with service hook, inclusions, workflow, and scope limits
Buyer FAQs answering at least 6 common service questions
Original gallery assets (primary card, sample showcases) created in Canva or Photoshop
Structured buyer requirement form with mandatory and optional intake questions
Three-tier package pricing (Basic, Standard, Premium) with defined deliverables and turnaround times
Supported Gig Extras, revision allowances, and clear scope exclusions
Pre-launch quality checklist and platform policy compliance review

components.title: Deliverable 02 — Fiverr Gig Dossier B
deliverables: Second meaningfully differentiated service offer based on student's existing expertise
Distinct buyer segment, deliverable scope, and positioning rationale
Dedicated gig title, search tags, description, and buyer FAQs
Separate original gallery visuals demonstrating relevant deliverable samples
Specific buyer requirement intake form tailored to the distinct service
Complete Basic, Standard, and Premium packages with differentiated pricing and delivery schedules
Independent quality review and compliance check

components.title: Deliverable 03 — Fiverr Pricing & Profitability Calculator
deliverables: Google Sheets model with documented formulas and editable platform fee assumption (default 80% freelancer share)
Labor cost calculation: Estimated Work Hours × Internal Hourly Cost
Direct production expenses (stock licensing, fonts, project tools)
Estimated contribution: Fiverr Seller Earnings - Total Direct Costs
Estimated operating profit: Contribution - Allocated Operating Overhead
Effective hourly earnings metric: Fiverr Earnings ÷ Total Work Hours
Seven scenario stress tests: Basic, Standard, Premium, extra revision round, increased labor hours, added asset expense, and exchange rate fluctuation

components.title: Deliverable 04 — Complete Simulated Order Workflow
deliverables: Stage 01 (Buyer Enquiry): Professional initial response clarifying requirements and next steps
Stage 02 (Order Requirements): Structured intake recording goals, specs, reference assets, and timeline
Stage 03 (Package Selection): Mapping buyer brief to appropriate package and confirming custom offer terms
Stage 04 (Confirmation): Scope summary, milestone commitments, and agreed assumptions
Stage 05 (Production Planning): Task breakdown, production schedule, and QA checklist
Stage 06 (Sample Production): Actual sample deliverable executed using existing service skills
Stage 07 (Quality Review): Pre-delivery audit verifying brief compliance, technical specs, and originality
Stage 08 (Buyer Feedback): Professional response to a simulated revision request and scope adjustment
Stage 09 (Final Delivery): Formal delivery message, completed deliverable package, and usage instructions
Stage 10 (Post-Delivery Review): Reflection documenting time spent, effective hourly rate, and workflow improvements

components.title: Deliverable 05 — Seller Readiness & Policy Audit
deliverables: Account eligibility and identity integrity assessment
Marketplace policy checklist (prohibited services, IP rights, on-platform communications)
Search visibility factors audit (relevance, metadata, client satisfaction signals)
Success Score and seller levels understanding review
Account security protocol (2FA, phishing detection, safe file handling)
90-day marketplace readiness improvement plan with identified gap closures

faq.question: What is Fiverr Freelancing & Gig Management?
faq.answer: It is a practical course covering Fiverr service positioning, gig creation, package pricing, buyer communication and order-delivery workflows.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for complete beginners?
faq.answer: It introduces Fiverr from the fundamentals, but students should already have at least one marketable service skill.

faq.question: Will this course teach graphic design or video editing?
faq.answer: No. It teaches how to present and deliver an existing service through Fiverr. Specialist technical skills are taught separately.

faq.question: Is a Fiverr account required?
faq.answer: No. Eligible learners may use their own accounts, while others can complete equivalent offline gig dossiers.

faq.question: Will I create real Fiverr gigs?
faq.answer: You will prepare two complete gig dossiers. Eligible students may choose to create live gigs, but publication and platform approval are not mandatory.

faq.question: What will I learn about gig optimization?
faq.answer: You will learn service positioning, relevant titles, search tags, descriptions, FAQs, original gallery assets and buyer requirements.

faq.question: Does gig optimization guarantee page-one rankings?
faq.answer: No. Fiverr search results depend on multiple factors and can vary by buyer, query, competition and performance.

faq.question: Will I learn Basic, Standard and Premium packages?
faq.answer: Yes. You will design three-tier pricing structures, extras, revision allowances and realistic delivery times.

faq.question: How much does Fiverr deduct from seller earnings?
faq.answer: Fiverr's currently documented standard freelancer share is 80% of completed order amounts. The course teaches current fees and how to verify changes.

faq.question: Is Fiverr's 80% seller share the same as 80% profit?
faq.answer: No. Sellers still need to account for labor, project expenses, overhead, applicable taxes and payout costs.

faq.question: Will I learn to calculate gig profitability?
faq.answer: Yes. You will build a working pricing calculator and compare different package and workload scenarios.

faq.question: What is Fiverr's Success Score?
faq.answer: It is a marketplace performance measure related to factors such as customer experience and order quality. It is not a guaranteed result of completing training.

faq.question: Will I become a Top Rated Seller?
faq.answer: Top Rated status depends on Fiverr's eligibility requirements and evaluation. The course does not guarantee seller-level advancement.

faq.question: Will I learn buyer communication?
faq.answer: Yes. You will practise enquiries, requirements clarification, custom offers, progress updates, revisions and final delivery messages.

faq.question: Will I complete a simulated order?
faq.answer: Yes. You will practise one complete order from buyer brief to final handover.

faq.question: Can I use AI for Fiverr work?
faq.answer: Fiverr allows responsible AI assistance, but sellers must comply with policies, client preferences and originality/quality requirements.

faq.question: Can AI produce all my client work automatically?
faq.answer: AI cannot replace the seller's responsibility for professional skill, accuracy, customization, originality and quality.

faq.question: Will the course teach Fiverr account security?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn about phishing, account integrity, verification, prohibited services and responsible communication.

faq.question: Is the course different from Upwork training?
faq.answer: Yes. This course focuses on Fiverr's gig-based marketplace. Upwork has distinct profile, proposal, contract and payment workflows.

faq.question: Can I complete the course without any clients?
faq.answer: Yes. The portfolio uses simulated buyer briefs and does not require real orders or revenue.

faq.question: Does this course guarantee freelance income?
faq.answer: No. Income depends on skills, demand, competition, quality, pricing, account eligibility and actual buyer decisions.

faq.question: What portfolio will I complete?
faq.answer: Two gig dossiers or eligible live gigs, original galleries, requirement forms, three-tier pricing, a profitability calculator, a simulated order and readiness review.

faq.question: Do I need paid Fiverr advertising?
faq.answer: No. Fiverr Ads and other paid promotional tools are not mandatory.

faq.question: What is the duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course lasts five weeks, includes 40 guided learning hours and has a listed fee of ₹5,900, subject to Nova Skills' verified pricing and tax policy.
